描述_EN: the ‘moustache’ detail on the pockets of the coat is found on the toe of the traditional hunter wellington boot. they also wanted to create a look inspired by expeditions into extreme environments, namely outer space and the ocean floor. when creating their debut autumn/winter 2014 collection for london fashion week, hunter aimed to celebrate the brand’s 150 year heritage. this men's ensemble consisting of coat, trousers, bag and boots encapsulates this approach, developing classic british styles, combined with materials inspired by scuba diving.
描述_ZN: 大衣口袋上的 "小胡子 "细节在传统的Hunter Wellington靴子的鞋头上也有体现。 他们还想创造一个灵感来自于对极端环境的探险，即外太空和海底的探险。 在为伦敦时装周设计他们的首次2014秋冬系列时，Hunter旨在庆祝品牌150年的遗产。 这套由大衣、长裤、包和靴子组成的男装套装囊括了这种方法，发展了经典的英国风格，结合了灵感来自潜水的材料。
